isc_provisioning._note: Simplified model of provisioning in SailPoint Identity Security Cloud (ISC). Operation, channel and status names are this course's own labels for the ISC behaviour they describe; ISC itself records account activities with account requests (Create, Modify, Disable ...) and attribute requests (Add, Remove, Set).

channel_rules.name: service desk integration on the source
read-only or unknown source: manual task to the source owner

PLAN_ERROR: Open the source's Create Account provisioning policy (Admin > Connections > Sources > the source > Accounts) and check each required field
Check the identity's attribute values on the identity details page: a required identity attribute is empty or the generator ran out of unique values
Search Account Activities for the identity and read the error on the failed activity
MULTIPLE_ACCOUNTS: Open the identity's Accounts tab to see every account it has on the source
Resubmit the request and select which account receives the access
REJECTED: Check that the source, role, access profile or lifecycle state exists and is spelled exactly as configured
Check whether the role or access profile is marked requestable before it is offered in an access request
DIRECT_FAILED: Search Account Activities for the identity and open the failed activity to read the connector's error
Search Events for failed provisioning events on the source around the same time
Run Test Connection on the source and check the service account's permissions in the target system

Raise the connector logging level for the source temporarily (for example DEBUG through the virtual appliance cluster log configuration), read ccg.log on the virtual appliance, then set the level back

concepts.provisioning plan: The list of account and attribute changes ISC works out for one identity before it sends anything to a source.
concepts.create account provisioning policy: The per-source form that says which attributes a new account gets and where each value comes from.
concepts.unique account ID generator: A create policy field that builds a username from a pattern and adds a counter until the value is not taken.
concepts.attribute sync: Keeping an account attribute equal to an identity attribute, pushing the new value when the identity changes.
concepts.service desk integration: A connection to a ticketing system so a provisioning change becomes a ticket for a person to complete.
concepts.manual task: A work item ISC gives the source owner when the source cannot be changed by a connector.
concepts.account activity: The searchable record of one provisioning transaction, with its status and any error.
concepts.identity refresh: Reprocessing an identity so role membership criteria, lifecycle state and attribute sync are evaluated again.
